caption: The drawing features a single, large, symmetrical object centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background. The object is depicted in shades of gray and black, suggesting it is rendered in graphite or charcoal. It consists of two mirrored, vertically oriented, ornate shapes that resemble stylized vegetal or floral forms, with curled, scroll-like ends. Each half of the design crosses the other at the center, creating an overall "X" formation. Both arms of the design are pierced by a series of evenly spaced round holes, and the inner structure is accentuated with additional curvilinear lines and openwork detailing. The surface of the object is shaded to indicate volume and depth. There is a small, neat handwritten signature and date at the lower right of the image. The background is otherwise empty except for some slight discoloration and faint smudges around the edges.
title: Gate
